whatChanged: NEW: Bon Secours Mercy Health has agreed to take Surgery Partners private at $23.50 a share in cash, a 49% premium, valuing it at about $5.7bn; Bain Capital keeps its ~38.5% stake (sgry-bon-secours-take-private)
NEW: Ares Capital will buy Apollo-managed BDC MidCap Financial Investment for about $10.88 a share in stock and cash, a 30% premium and roughly $2.6bn of enterprise value (arcc-mfic-acquisition)

ADVANCED: Intesa Sanpaolo has ECB authorisation to take control of Monte dei Paschi ahead of the 29 October MPS shareholder vote; Consob and Italian antitrust sign-offs remain (isp-bmps-takeover-offer) (confirmed → approved)

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsors, strategics and insiders keep taking listed businesses off public markets. Bon Secours Mercy Health agreed to buy Surgery Partners at $23.50 a share while Bain keeps its stake (sgry-bon-secours-take-private). EQT signed a board-recommended €46.50-a-share cash offer for Qiagen (qgen-eqt-take-private), and EQT Infrastructure signed a A$3.095-a-share scheme for Cleanaway (cwy-eqt-infrastructure-take-private). Penske Corporation and Mitsui are buying out the Penske Automotive float (pag-penske-mitsui-take-private), a GTCR-led consortium with Elliott is buying CCC Intelligent Solutions (cccs-gtcr-elliott-take-private), and Thoma Bravo's Proofpoint is buying Varonis (vrns-proofpoint-acquisition). Ithaca Holdings is taking Bumble private (bmbl-ithaca-take-private), Viatris is tendering for Pacira (pcrx-viatris-acquisition), and Cencora is buying out American Oncology Network (cor-aon-acquisition). Tata's Iveco offer has cleared its 80% threshold (ivg-tata-motors-takeover-offer). New approaches keep coming: AVID has topped Warburg Pincus for Ingenia (ina-avid-takeover-proposal), and Challenger rejected a A$11.80 bid from its largest shareholder, TAL Daiichi Life (cgf-tal-daiichi-takeover-proposal). EP Group's Fnac Darty tender has EU clearance (fnac-ep-group-takeover-bid), while Aurora's board continues to resist Curaleaf's hostile bid (acb-curaleaf-takeover-bid).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Regulators, politicians and courts, not the parties, keep deciding deals. Kimberly-Clark has cleared China's in-depth SAMR review for Kenvue after paying for EU and Australian clearance with feminine-care divestments (kmb-kenvue-acquisition). AkzoNobel and Axalta have formally offered EU remedies, including selling AkzoNobel's European refinish business, and the Commission's deadline has moved into November (akza-axalta-merger). The ECB has cleared UniCredit to control Commerzbank, but Berlin still opposes it (cbk-unicredit-takeover), and it has now also authorised Intesa to control Monte dei Paschi, leaving Consob and Italy's antitrust authority, which may demand extra branch sales (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). Brazil's CADE cleared Transocean-Valaris without conditions (val-transocean-acquisition), and EP Group's Fnac Darty bid needed EU merger clearance (fnac-ep-group-takeover-bid).

themes.label: Large-caps scaling up buybacks on surplus cash
themes.note: Companies with surplus capital keep expanding buybacks, each tying the larger programme to a specific capital tailwind. GM authorized a new $20bn buyback with its Q3 results (gm-buyback-2026), TD has OSFI approval to buy back up to another C$10bn (td-buyback-2026), and Simpson Manufacturing replaced a $200m authorization with $1.0bn (ssd-buyback-2026).

themes.label: European incumbents consolidating domestic rivals for scale
themes.note: Europe's large banks and industrials are bidding for rivals to reach the scale of US and Chinese peers, while controlling shareholders, governments and supervisors decide the outcomes. BASF has reportedly raised its Evonik offer to €24 a share, about €11.2bn, with RAG-Stiftung's ~43% stake decisive (evk-basf-acquisition). The ECB has cleared UniCredit to go past 30% of Commerzbank despite Berlin's opposition (cbk-unicredit-takeover). Intesa Sanpaolo now has ECB authorisation for its sweetened, Delfin-backed offer for Monte dei Paschi, which hinges on the 29 October MPS vote (isp-bmps-takeover-offer).

themes.label: Governments selling state-held stakes to strategic and financial buyers
themes.note: Governments are privatising long-held stakes and picking buyers on both price and industrial plan. India's cabinet approved selling 60.72% of IDBI Bank to Fairfax (ffh-idbi-bank-acquisition), and Portugal chose Lufthansa's all-cash offer for 44.9% of TAP Air Portugal while keeping a 50.1% majority (lha-tap-stake-acquisition).
